context:
Training Gym R59 completed! ALL 4 PASS INCLUDING TIER 9 TARJAN'S SCC!

R59 RESULTS (all 10/10, all clean):
1. dfs-graph-001 (T6) - DFS with 3-color cycle detection (WHITE/GRAY/BLACK). Topological sort via finish times.
2. kruskal-mst-001 (T7) - Kruskal MST with Union-Find. Sort edges, greedily add if different components. Disconnect check: n-1 edges.
3. prim-mst-001 (T7) - Prim MST with min-heap. Start from vertex, push crossing edges, pick minimum. Lazy deletion.
4. tarjan-scc-001 (T9) - Tarjan's SCC! disc[] + low[] + stack. low[v]==disc[v] → root of SCC, pop stack until v. O(V+E).

DB: 274 exercises, 475 attempts, avg 9.89, 94.5% perfect. 222 passed.
25+ consecutive rounds all 10/10. Tier 9+ = 55 passed.

Key algorithm: Tarjan's SCC - index[v] = discovery order, low[v] = lowest index reachable from subtree. On stack tracks current path. When low[v]==index[v], pop everything above (inclusive) as one SCC.
decisions: DFS cycle: GRAY → back edge = cycle. BLACK = done. Topo: reverse finish order.
Kruskal: sort edges by weight, union-find, stop at n-1 edges. Disconnect = fewer than n-1.
Prim: min-heap of (weight, vertex, parent). Lazy skip visited. Parent=-1 for start.
Tarjan SCC: index+low+stack+on_stack. low[v]=min(index[v], low[w] for tree edges, index[w] for back edges on stack). Root when low[v]==index[v].
